question: Which foundation mainly funds the Human Protein Atlas?

turns.text:
The Human Protein Atlas is funded by the **Knut and Alice Wallenberg Foundation** (Knut & Alice Wallenberg Foundation).

Sources:
- Human Protein Atlas Acknowledgments: https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/acknowledgments
- Human Protein Atlas Wikipedia entry: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_Protein_Atlas
